title: Carol A
content: I was escorted away from my body into a vast darkness by two beings. I wasn't fearful of the passage because of their reassuring presence. I felt safe and content to leave my body and go with them. They seemed male, clothed in glistening white tunics, mostly human in form but not solid as humans are here. They both had peaceful, kind demeanors. They escorted me to a room like an anteroom. I could detect crowds of spirits and divine music flowing toward a great light in another area, but that area was blocked to me. Still, I could hear magnetic music unlike anything I'd ever heard. It seemed three-dimensional and directional, flowing toward what I assumed was the creator. I was curious but understood that area wasn't part of why I was there. My guides immediately grasped my curiosity and gave off gentle amusement while redirecting my attention to the room we were in. In this room, I felt awe. It was high-tech and streamlined, with walls like frosted glass block. There was a peaceful white that radiated gentle light. My spirit escorts seemed assigned to me and knew me intimately. I sensed they'd been with me always, at least since my birth on earth. One guide seemed more senior and communicated more with me. There were no words, but evidence of clear understanding, even of spontaneous questions. The main answer provided was a godly perspective on the problem of evil. I'd struggled with the question, "If God is all-loving, how can he allow such horrors?" I was allowed to gaze into a high-tech, stacked-drawer system of time and history. I looked backward through thousands of layers representing intervals of time. The layers interacted and came alive as I viewed them. I could see individual layers and their vertical implications from past to present. Everything was intentionally woven together, forming a beautiful three-dimensional tapestry from above. Events that humans consider tragic were darker colors but didn't ruin the overall beauty because these events were a small part of the fullness of time. Seeing the continuity of events that were normally beyond human grasp, I accepted that all that occurs is part of an intricate tapestry woven through the ages. I felt touched that God knew my anguish and sent these guides to help with my despair over man's inhumanity and God's seeming lack of intervention. In that room, my mind had no human limits. I absorbed information with perfect understanding. I wish I could have brought that ability back. I also wish I'd asked my guides' names, but I didn't because they felt so familiar at the time. Over the years, I've sometimes felt them at my side during times of distress. The experience showed me we are loved and watched over. God knows our every thought and action. I now believe in personal angels. Before this experience, I thought that was nonsense.
